records.name: Stitch Loop
records.tagline: Google’s AI agent that ships fixes and watches the metric
records.description: Stitch Loop is an experimental product agent from Google Labs. It connects to your GitHub repo and live product data like logs, user behavior and feedback, proposes fixes, builds them in a cloud sandbox and opens a pull request. Nothing merges without human review. Built-in loops cover security, latency and accessibility, plus custom goals like checkout conversion. It keeps monitoring the metric after launch. Waitlist open worldwide, with priority for eligible Google AI Ultra users.

records.name: WaitFeed
records.tagline: Tech feed inside agent wait time
records.description: Your agent is working. You’re sitting idle or bleeding focus into random tabs. Every wait is dead time that breaks your flow. WaitFeed kills it. It turns every wait into a powerful tech briefing, so you stay informed and locked in without ever leaving your terminal. Fresh dev stories, repos, and live developer discussions stream straight into your terminal. Never in your way. 100% local. Zero API keys. Zero tokens. Free and open source. One command and it’s live.

records.name: Glassmail
records.tagline: A fast Mac email app with AI that never leaves your Mac
records.description: Most new email apps charge you every month and send your mail to their servers so their AI can read it. Glassmail doesn't. It's a native Mac app for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and any IMAP account, and its AI runs on your Mac. Ask "what needs me today?" and get an answer. Type "yes, but next week" and get a reply in your own voice. Clear your inbox one key at a time. There's no mail server and no subscription. You pay once, and it's yours.

records.name: AI Context Flow MCP
records.tagline: Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team
records.description: Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back.

records.name: Shipyard
records.tagline: MCP for Claude, Cursor and Codex to Automate Integrations
records.description: Built for the vibecoding era, where anyone can build an app in a night and the slow part is everything around it. Shipyard is a local CLI and MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Connect your accounts once, then every new product gets its domain, DNS, hosting, database, email and payments set up automatically in about an hour. Your AI gets a build prompt for the exact stack. Ship more ideas, faster. Your keys never leave your computer.

records.name: Beat Watcher
records.tagline: Fast Apple Watch heart rate alerts you can share with family
records.description: Beat Watcher alerts you on Apple Watch the moment your heart rate goes above or below limits you set with the Digital Crown. Background Mode keeps watching when your wrist is down. Alert Sharing sends your alerts to family or friends you choose, in their own Beat Watcher app, free for them. The optional iPhone app can sound Critical Alerts on silent or Do Not Disturb and keeps an Alert History with notes and CSV export. People use it for pacing with POTS, stress awareness and rest.

records.name: Publicit
records.tagline: Omnichannel ad infrastructure for marketers and AI agents
records.description: Publicit is self-serve infrastructure to buy advertising across connected TV, street screens and mobile from one API. Choose audience and budget, upload your creative, and our real-time bidder buys the spaces on every channel, with delivery measured hour by hour. Each space shows its price before you buy. Sign-up is free. Built on OpenRTB, with a native MCP server to run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT.

records.name: Exa Websets V2
records.tagline: Build custom datasets from the live web, 4x faster
records.description: Websets v2 is Exa’s update to its tool for building custom datasets from live web data. Describe what you want in plain language and get rows with sources and reasoning for each match. Per Exa, v2 finds 20% more matches, runs 4x faster and costs about 2x less than v1. The monthly subscription is gone, usage draws from Exa credits, searches are $5 per 1,000 requests, and API access is open to all users on the usage plan.

records.name: AlterContacts
records.tagline: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead
records.description: AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.

records.name: SuperMailbox
records.tagline: Your email in one inbox, ready for AI
records.description: Bring Gmail, iCloud Mail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts into one inbox. Find emails by meaning across languages with semantic search. Create mail rules and share access with your team. Connect ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible AI assistant through MCP to summarize threads and draft replies, with separate permissions for AI access. Plans start at $4.99/month with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: OpenVorld
records.tagline: Give your AI agents a home you can see
records.description: OpenVorld is an open-source harness for AI agents, with a visible world on top. Every project is a pixel-art village, and every agent has a name, a role and a brain: Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. You watch the crew work, and they ask before they use a folder, a command or a website. Free, open source and local. No account needed.

records.name: Codemany
records.tagline: Run GitHub Actions 3x faster
records.description: Run GitHub Actions on your own infra. Codemany orchestrates the runners: a fresh VM for each job. 3x faster, and NO per-minute bill. Our CI bill went from $215 in October to $4 so far in November. Free 14 days, no card.

records.name: gitroots
records.tagline: Path-level GitHub access for developers and AI agents
records.description: gitroots is a governance layer for GitHub. Give each developer and AI agent access to only the paths they need, route their changes through approvals, and keep a searchable audit trail. Widen access to your code without handing over the whole repository.

records.name: Backspin
records.tagline: Learn to DJ in your browser, on real vinyl decks
records.description: Backspin teaches you to DJ in 21 short lessons that run on real turntables in your browser. It performs each move on the decks while you watch, then you try it and it tells you what to fix. Practice songs are built in, so you need no gear, no music files and no account. Free.

records.name: Prompt Puncher
records.tagline: The AI CEO Fighting Game
records.description: Prompt Puncher is a free browser fighting game where AI CEOs throw hands. Fight as Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and more. No downloads or signups required.

records.name: LoudFlow
records.tagline: We taught text to speech to think
records.description: Most voices read the letters. LoudFlow understands the sentence first, so it sounds like a person, not a machine. Watch the video to hear the difference. Then select text in any app, press two keys, and listen. In any voice, even your own. Free on Mac and Windows.

records.name: Smorza
records.tagline: Every Mac app gets its own volume and output
records.description: Smorza is a free, open source menu bar app that gives every Mac app its own volume, mute and output. Put a call in your AirPods and music on your speakers, or turn a loud browser down without touching anything else. No audio driver, macOS 14.4+.

records.name: Hollr
records.tagline: Push-to-talk for your family, on iPhone and Apple Watch
records.description: Hollr is a walkie-talkie for your family. Hold one button, say it, let go. It works on iPhone and Apple Watch, including kids' Family Setup watches with no iPhone. Read a message when you can't listen, or react with a tap. Free for two people.

records.name: Doddle
records.tagline: Draw on what your videos for 3D effects
records.description: Doddle is a camera for drawing on the world. Film a few steps, draw in the air or on a wall, and your lines stay where you put them. Pick a 3D pen, watch it draw itself, save a vertical video. Free to start; Pro is $6.99 once.

records.name: AnyProfile
records.tagline: Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows
records.description: Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows. Isolate cookies, proxies, Android 15 VMs & AI MCP locally, with zero monthly fees.

records.name: CROON
records.tagline: Live dubbing for whatever's playing on your iPhone
records.description: CROON dubs video or audio on your iPhone into your language as it plays, in a voice close to the speaker's. It works on top of the apps you already use. Turn CROON on once, then go back to your app and keep watching. When multiple people are talking, each keeps a separate voice. Free to download.

records.name: Diane
records.tagline: Turn any course into flashcards you'll actually remember
records.description: Diane turns any course (PDF, photo of notes, link, audio, video) into flashcards, a study sheet, a quiz and a podcast. Spaced repetition then plans daily reviews around your exam date. For high school, med, law and nursing students. iOS, Android & web.

records.name: CursorFlow
records.tagline: Mac screen recorder that zooms into your clicks for you
records.description: Native macOS screen recorder with automatic zoom, smooth cursor motion and a real-time multi-track editor.

records.name: Game Filter Studio
records.tagline: Turn your photos into GTA-inspired artwork.
records.description: Transform your photos into cinematic illustrated video game-inspired artwork with Game Filter Studio. Upload, custoTA Filter Studio is a creative toolkit that transforms ordinary photos into illustrated artwork inspired by the iconic visual style of open-world video games. Upload a photo, choose a visual style and generate your own cover art. Explore creative presets, experiment with visual effects and customize your designs with browser-based tools.

records.name: Student Swipe
records.tagline: Find student teammates and build projects together
records.description: Find student teammates with complementary skills and shared interests. Student Swipe helps New Zealand tertiary students discover people by campus and skills, connect through mutual matches, and organise SkillSprints with team chat, tasks, milestones, shared files and meetings. Available on web, iOS and Android, with a free tier and optional Pro and Max plans.

records.name: TopSMM Free Tools
records.tagline: 33 free creator tools: live counters, AI writer, QR studio
records.description: Free toolkit for creators and small businesses, mostly no signup. Live YouTube subscriber, view and Telegram member counters. AI writer for captions, bios, titles and scripts in English, Hinglish or Hindi. Instagram engagement and earnings calculators, YouTube monetization checker, QR codes with logo and UPI, tag extractor and thumbnail downloader.

records.name: InvoiceKit
records.tagline: Professional invoices in the browser — free, no account
records.description: InvoiceKit is a single-file invoice generator that runs entirely in your browser: your logo, unlimited saved invoices, duplicate and delete, PAID and UNPAID stamps, automatic numbering, English and Indonesian, eight currencies, saved clients and business profile, JSON export and import. Your data never leaves your device because there is no server. It is built for freelancers, small businesses and online sellers.

records.name: IQFluence MCP
records.tagline: Find and vet influencers inside Claude or ChatGPT
records.description: IQFluence MCP brings influencer data into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Search 455M+ Instagram, TikTok and YouTube creators. See which creators promoted your competitor, find lookalikes who haven't worked with them yet and read what their audience asks in the comments. Check fake followers and audience overlap, then set a budget per creator and get a draft media plan. You see the cost before every paid step. Start from 15 ready-made prompts. 5 free credits, no card required.

records.name: BlurbBio Fantasy Name Generator
records.tagline: Character names with real meanings, for fiction writers
records.description: Free name generator built for novelists. Pick a culture, era or fantasy race (elf, dwarf, Celtic myth, Welsh, Japanese and more) and get names that fit, each with its meaning or origin where one is documented. It covers 23 cultures, 16 character types and 7 mythologies, with 1,500+ hand-curated etymologies. Names follow the phonetics of their culture instead of copying famous fantasy IP. No signup, no limits.

records.name: ArticlePix
records.tagline: Let AI find stock photos for your article
records.description: Paste your article and ArticlePix suggests a cover image plus free stock photos for the spots between paragraphs where an image would help. Each spot comes with 12 photos from Pixabay and a short reason for the pick. It finds real photos instead of generating them. Any language. First analysis free, then $5 for 5 articles.

records.name: RingBack India
records.tagline: Missed-call follow-up and bookings for Indian businesses
records.description: RingBack India helps service businesses organise enquiries, follow-up and booking requests. Share booking links and manage appointments, enquiries and UPI billing. Current zero-spend operation supports booking requests and manual Gmail/WhatsApp follow-up; automatic SMS and paid API messaging are off. Optional messaging requires supported numbers and configured providers. Check current availability and pricing before paying.

records.name: GuideEye
records.tagline: Hands-free AI assistant for blind and low-vision people
records.description: GuideEye is a hands-free AI assistant for blind and low-vision people. A phone clipped to your chest watches the path ahead while you talk to it like a person: it calls out hazards, remembers where you left things, and reads back a price before confirming any purchase. We're sharing it now to get real feedback from the accessibility community before going further. Not a replacement for a cane, guide dog, orientation training, or emergency services.

records.name: Period & Ovulation Tracker
records.tagline: Private - AI tracking of period, ovulation and fertility
records.description: Period & Ovulation Tracker is a private period tracker and menstrual cycle calendar. Log your period, see an estimated fertile window and ovulation day, and follow pregnancy weeks. No account is required. Your cycle stays on your phone. Predictions are estimates from the cycle you log. They are not a diagnosis, a guarantee of fertility, or a form of birth control. Period & Ovulation Tracker is a personal cycle journal and calendar.

records.name: designali
records.tagline: Where thoughtful design meets production-ready code
records.description: Where thoughtful design meets production-ready code. I design and build digital experiences that look great, feel intuitive, and work beautifully.

records.name: AstroMirror
records.tagline: Natal chart readings you can trace back to your chart
records.description: AstroMirror draws your natal chart for free, no sign-up, using the Swiss Ephemeris and Placidus houses. It reads the chart from its aspects first, in the London school of psychological astrology, and every paragraph names the placements it is based on, so you can check it against your own chart. Longer readings are written by a language model and can be read as full samples before you pay. No predictions, but "know yourself".

records.name: RoutinePulse: Habit Tracker
records.tagline: Build better habits. Stay consistent. Make every day count.
records.description: RoutinePulse helps you build meaningful daily habits, track your progress, maintain streaks, and turn small actions into lasting routines. Building good habits shouldn't feel complicated. Whether you're trying to improve your daily routine, become more productive, or focus on personal wellness, RoutinePulse makes it easier to stay on track. 🚀 Try RoutinePulse Start building better routines, one day at a time! Your routine. Your progress. Your pulse.

records.name: AEGIS-DocIntel
records.tagline: AI-powered intelligence for complex documents
records.description: AEGIS-DocIntel turns complex PDFs, technical specs, and multi-column documents into structured, grounded intelligence. Featuring layout-aware Kahn DAG parsing, submodular knapsack context optimization, and verifiable bounding-box coordinate citations so you never have to trust an unverified answer again.

records.name: CVpass
records.tagline: Upload your resume, see what's holding it back
records.description: CVpass reads your resume next to a job post and shows which skills the job asks for that your resume leaves out. You get a score out of 100 and a suggested rewrite for each weak point, which you can accept or skip. The site is in English, French, Spanish, German, Dutch and Italian. More than 6,000 resume analyses so far. Built in France. It won't promise you a job. It helps you send a resume that says what you can do.

records.name: TrustComponent Monitoring
records.tagline: Uptime monitoring and status pages, hosted in the EU
records.description: Monitor websites, APIs and servers with 16 check types, as often as every 30 seconds, with nothing to install. When something breaks, alerts go out by email, SMS, voice call, Slack, Teams and more, with escalation chains of up to 20 steps. Outages turn into pre-filled incident drafts, and hosted status pages on your own domain keep customers informed. Everything is hosted in the EU, with a GDPR data processing agreement included.

records.name: Element Legion
records.tagline: Lead three elemental squads against giant beasts
records.description: A mobile auto-battler where you command three squads of elemental soldiers. Move with one stick, your soldiers fight on their own, and your army grows into a horde as you play. - Pick 3 of 6 elements: Fire, Water, Thunder, Wind, Ice, Grass - Switch formations: Ring, Charge, Scatter - Overlapping elements fuse into storms and steam - Survive 2 minutes and a giant beast with an elemental shield appears Free, no ads, no account. Try the browser demo, no install needed.

records.name: Flitover
records.tagline: Hire freelancers and pay through milestone escrow
records.description: Flitover is a freelance marketplace for hiring developers, AI engineers, web designers and ad specialists. Post a job free, compare proposals, and fund each milestone into escrow: payment is released only when you approve the work. Freelancers keep 90% with a flat 10% fee.

records.name: SponsorshipNow
records.tagline: Sponsorship tools for grassroots clubs and societies
records.description: Help your grassroots club or society turn local support into lasting partnerships. Create a shareable Showcase of sponsorship opportunities, organise agreements and invoices, and track your season’s funding in one place. Built for the volunteers who keep communities going. 0% platform commission, always. Free for up to three sponsors. Payment processing fees are separate.

records.name: Qrinly
records.tagline: Dynamic QR codes and smart links that evolve with you
records.description: **Keep the QR. Change what it opens.** Qrinly is an all-in-one platform for dynamic QR codes, short links, file sharing, and smart routing. Update destinations without reprinting, route visitors by location, language, or time, and A/B test different links. Customize QR codes with your branding, track scans with detailed analytics, and manage everything from one dashboard. Perfect for restaurants, events, businesses, and marketing campaigns. **One QR. Endless possibilities.**

records.name: Trivocity
records.tagline: Passport, visa & RTO services in Pune since 2014
records.description: Trivocity is a passport, visa and RTO agent in Pune, India, serving residents since 2014 — one office for your whole file, from the first document check to delivery. What Trivocity does: - Fresh passports, Tatkal passports, passport renewal and re-issue - Minor and newborn passports - Lost and damaged passport re-issues - Name, address and date-of-birth corrections - Tourist visas (Dubai & UAE, Singapore, UK, USA, Vietnam, China, Schengen Europe)

records.name: Narracore
records.tagline: A browser screenplay editor you write with Enter and Tab
records.description: Narracore is a browser-based screenplay editor built by a small team, for everyone who loves writing stories. Still in development. Write with just Enter and Tab: action, character names and dialogue are laid out in screenplay format as you type.

records.name: Avantium App
records.tagline: All-in-one trades app (1-30 crew) + Voice AI Secretary
records.description: Avantium App runs trade, installation & remodeling teams of 1–30 people from iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac & PC (4.9★). Unifies all 33 features in one plan: voice quotes with Sofi (free 24/7 WhatsApp & mic AI secretary using your catalog), multi-chapter renovations, live GPS crew & route map, 100% offline work orders with signature, AI receipt scan & European e-invoicing across 12 editions (from €29/mo, 14-day free trial).

records.name: LumivoPay
records.tagline: Virtual Cards for Global Advertising & Ecommerce Spend
records.description: LumivoPay provides virtual cards and spend controls for cross-border ecommerce businesses, advertising agencies, and global teams managing ad accounts, store tools, and budgets.

records.name: Latte Calendar
records.tagline: What if Fantastical, Granola and NotebookLM had a baby?
records.description: Latte is a browser calendar built around your meetings. Before, it briefs you from past meetings, tasks, and files. During, it transcribes and suggests questions live. After, it writes a summary, creates tasks, and tracks what people promised you. Chat with AI across your meeting and file library, add events by voice, text, or photo, and sync with Google, Outlook, iCloud, or Yahoo. Customize with 30+ themes, or create your own look with any font, color, or background. Free plan + no-signup demo.

records.name: Marketflip
records.tagline: Instant Alerts for Facebook Marketplace and more.
records.description: Marketflip delivers instant marketplace notifications for Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, Kijiji, Offerup, eBay, and Gumtree. Get real-time alerts for new listings and maximize your flipping profits.

records.name: Knock a Day
records.tagline: 12-day offer calendars for online shops, drafted in a minute
records.description: Paste your shop's address and get a draft offer calendar in about a minute: your own products, one discount and one code per day, your colours and logo. Edit anything and preview free. Shoppers open one door a day; future doors and codes stay hidden until their day. Works with Shopify, WooCommerce, a Google Shopping feed or your product pages, and prices always come from your shop. Publish for €99 / $99 (launch price, was 149). Agencies and packs of 5+: from €79 down to €59 a calendar.

records.name: REDACT BTP
records.tagline: AI that writes tender responses for construction companies
records.description: REDACT BTP helps French construction contractors answer public and private tenders. Upload the tender documents: it sorts every file, extracts the award criteria and their weighting, then writes the technical proposal criterion by criterion, exported to Word. It also prepares the admin forms (DC1, DC2), the safety plan, a Gantt schedule, and checks the bill of quantities against specs and drawings. Built by a site manager. French-language product, hosted in France.

records.name: Logomax
records.tagline: A fast, easy-to-use logo studio built for founders.
records.description: Ship your MVP without getting stuck on branding. Design, customize, and export crisp SVG and PNG logos in minutes.

records.name: LoudFlow
records.tagline: We taught text to speech to think
records.description: Most voices read the letters. LoudFlow understands the sentence first, so it sounds like a person, not a machine. Watch the video to hear the difference. Then select text in any app, press two keys, and listen. In any voice, even your own. Free on Mac and Windows.

records.name: Cat-ToDo - Neko ToDo
records.tagline: Finish a to-do, feed your cat, watch it grow
records.description: Cat-ToDo (ねこToDo) is a cute task manager from a solo developer in Japan. Every time you complete a to-do, your cat gets fed and grows a little. Name your cat, feed it 35 times, and it sets off on a journey — recorded forever in your departure notebook. - Complete tasks from the Home Screen widget (iOS 17+), no need to open the app - No account required, all data stays on your device - Free with ads, one-time premium (no subscription) to remove ads A small reason to finish one more task today.

records.name: JustSell
records.tagline: Canada's highest payouts for used devices
records.description: JustSell.ca is a Canadian device buyback service paying Canada's highest payouts for used iPhones, MacBooks, iPads, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel and Apple Watch. Free shipping across Canada, free pickup and local meetups in and around the GTA, same-day payment.
