records.name: Zealous Digital Sanctuary
records.tagline: Daily Devotional App for Christians
records.description: Step into your daily digital sanctuary, a Christ-centered home consolidating every rhythm of Christian devotion into one distraction-free space. Zealous is your one-stop center to deepen your walk with God, study Scripture, anchor daily prayer, and fellowship with believers worldwide, completely free from secular algorithms, ads, and noise.

records.name: Zanbots
records.tagline: AI SDR agents that scale your B2B pipeline on autopilot
records.description: Zanbots deploys autonomous fleets of AI SDR agents to run your entire B2B outbound engine. From signal-based prospect targeting and pre-warmed email/LinkedIn outreach to smart inbox triage and calendar booking, scale your pipeline without adding headcount.

records.name: LangFastPro
records.tagline: Free stories to help you read Hindi, Urdu, Arabic & more
records.description: Pick a short story in Hindi, Urdu, Arabic or one of five other languages and hit play. Each word lights up as it's read out. Can't read the script yet? Show it in English letters ("ek din" instead of एक दिन) or read the translation. Free, no signup.

records.name: XUBO IPTV Player
records.tagline: A modern, dark OLED IPTV player for all platforms
records.description: XUBO IPTV Player is a fast, clutter-free media player designed for your personal Xtream Codes API, M3U / M3U8, and MAC Portal playlists across all your screens.

records.name: Ibeiro
records.tagline: Run festivals & markets: vendors, venue maps, staff, tasks
records.description: Ibeiro is an event management tool for festivals, markets and fairs. Build vendor sign-up forms, review applications and permits, assign booths on a venue map, schedule staff, and track tasks and budgets, all in the browser. Try the full demo, no sign-up.

records.name: RelayLM
records.tagline: AI Gateway for Usage Tracking, Budgets, and Provider Routing
records.description: RelayLM is an AI gateway for OpenAI and Anthropic apps. Track usage, enforce per-user budgets, manage provider keys, and control AI spending from one endpoint.

records.name: Dibs
records.tagline: Free sign-up sheets. No ads, no accounts, no app.
records.description: Who's bringing what to Thanksgiving? Make a sign-up sheet in a minute, share one link, and people claim a spot from their phone. Free, no ads, no accounts. Works for volunteer shifts, carpools and class snacks too.

records.name: JPing
records.tagline: Simple, robust, self-hosted website monitoring
records.description: Know your uptime at all times—100% self-hosted, with no guesswork, no heavy dependencies, and a responsive UI that works seamlessly on desktop and mobile.

records.name: Amazon Opensearch Memory
records.tagline: Give AI agents memory that lasts
records.description: Add persistent memory to AI agents with searchable events, intelligent memory extraction, and context retrieval across sessions.

records.name: ChatGPT to PDF
records.tagline: Save a ChatGPT chat as a PDF, Word or Markdown file
records.description: For anyone who needs a chat outside the chat: a printout, an attachment to a report, a note in Obsidian, context for another model. Tables stay tables, images live inside the file, and Word gets equations you can edit. Built in your browser, so nothing queues.

records.name: MotComplice
records.tagline: A French word game to play with family, even on a video call
records.description: MotComplice is a word game in French on a 15x15 board, made for playing with the people you love. Open a private room, share a code, and play with 2 to 4 friends or family members, even when you live far apart: everyone sees the same board live, and an optional audio or video call is built in. Prefer to play alone? Challenge Octave, the owl, at 3 levels, offline and without an account. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Incognito Chat Saver
records.tagline: save your Incognito chat on your computer - 100% safe.
records.description: Incognito chats vanish when you close the window. Save any AI chat as atxt file on your computer in one click. Every message is labeled, and nothing is sent anywhere.

records.name: PM Job Market Trends by AllthingsPM
records.tagline: Weekly PM hiring data from 6,900+ company career pages
records.description: A free, live view of product manager hiring, read every week from the career pages of 6,900+ tech companies and startups (13,000+ open PM roles). See demand by level, cities and countries, remote vs hybrid, base pay by level and city, the skills and AI experience roles ask for, and who's hiring. Filter by country, level, work mode and company type.

records.name: Subtle
records.tagline: Beautiful captions for Claude Code, free and open source
records.description: Subtle is a free, open source caption skill for Claude Code and Codex.

records.name: SysDesignPrep.com
records.tagline: Practice system design interviews with an AI interviewer
records.description: An AI interviewer that sees your whiteboard, probes your design and scores you like a hiring panel. Every walkthrough is free once you sign in: 86 questions, 493 deep dives, 199 guides. Pro is one payment, no subscription.

records.name: Tabnivo
records.tagline: Check bookmark links and tidy idle tabs
records.description: Find broken bookmarks and tidy idle tabs in Chrome and Edge. Preview and recover cleanups for free. Paid plans run your idle rules automatically.

records.name: LinkFeed
records.tagline: A Chrome extension that gives LinkedIn X’s layout
records.description: LinkedIn's feed always felt cluttered to me: a top bar, three columns of cards, ads in the sidebar. X's layout is much easier to read, so I built LinkFeed, a Chrome extension that gives LinkedIn that layout.

records.name: Click
records.tagline: Build an Online Store From One Photo in 60 Seconds
records.description: Click lets you create a fully functional online store in seconds. Upload a product photo and instantly generate product pages, marketing content, and shipping-ready storefronts powered by AI.

records.name: ImageReveal
records.tagline: 100 image reveals for React portfolios and landing pages
records.description: ImageReveal is a library of 100 image reveal effects for portfolios, landing pages, and case studies. Preview every effect live with your own photo, then install the one you need as a React component. The free Halftone Dissolve ships as a coding-agent skill for any React project. Pro Pack unlocks the other 99 reveals for US$5 once — no subscription.

records.name: Wonderblok
records.tagline: The design canvas your AI coding agent works on
records.description: A design canvas your AI coding agent works on. Universe is built in: 429 battle-tested app flows, so you never start from a blank canvas. Claude Code or Codex draws them on your design tokens, and every edit is checked. Free on macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: CareerSignal
records.tagline: Find out why recruiters ignore you — then fix it
records.description: CareerSignal scores your LinkedIn and CV out of 100, shows exactly what's hurting your visibility, and helps you fix it — with AI rewrites and keyword gap analysis. Most job seekers get rejected before a human reads their profile. CareerSignal tells you why. ✦ AI rewrites for headline, about section, and CV ✦ Visibility score with breakdown ✦ Keyword gap analysis — paste any job description ✦ Done-for-you packages ✦ English and Arabic Free tier. Built for MENA job seekers.

records.name: Rufus Mail
records.tagline: Professional email signatures for Apple Mail on iPhone
records.description: Apple Mail on iPhone only supports plain-text signatures. Rufus Mail lets you build a professional one in under a minute, with your logo, photo, social links and even your handwritten signature, then paste it into Mail settings. Dozens of templates or a fully custom editor, a different signature for each account, on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, 7 languages. Free to try; a yearly subscription unlocks export.

records.name: Anvikare
records.tagline: The calm baby tracker for sleepless nights
records.description: Anvikare is a calm baby tracker for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, built for the sleepless early months. Log a feed, diaper or nap in one tap, or just say it out loud. See when the next feed is due and which side to start on, time feeds from the Lock Screen, and use a dim, one-handed night mode at 3 AM. Pro adds a nap window that learns your baby's sleep, partner sharing over iCloud and a one-page summary for the pediatrician. No account needed; your data stays in your own iCloud.

records.name: Free AI Token Calculator & Token Counter
records.tagline: What your prompt really costs on 21 AI models
records.description: Paste a text and see how many tokens it makes and what it costs, per call and per month, on 21 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek and Mistral. Models don't cut text into tokens the same way: at the same price per token, Claude Fable 5.2 costs about 1.5 times GPT-6.2 Astra on English text. The ratios are measured with each maker's own counter, in 30+ languages. Free, no sign-up, and your text stays in your browser.

records.name: Pick a Peak
records.tagline: Find a mountain to climb, and people to climb it with
records.description: Pick a Peak is a catalogue of 1.4 million peaks and 8,000+ mountain ranges you can filter by range, country and elevation, with weather, routes and huts on every peak page. On top sits a social layer for finding climbing partners: every mountain has a calendar showing who plans to go the same days, with a chat for each day. Drop a GPX or connect Strava to mark the summits you've reached, and take on ~100 peak-bagging challenges. Free, in 8 languages.

records.name: Next Chapter
records.tagline: Read or listen to the key ideas of bestsellers in 15 min
records.description: Most of us buy books we never finish. Next Chapter gives you the key ideas of 300+ bestsellers in about 15 minutes each — so you actually learn something every day. • Read or listen: every summary has natural-voice audio • Your own path: pick what you want to improve (focus, habits, money, confidence…) and get a reading plan built for it • Track progress: finish a book, rate it, see what's next • Works in the browser on any device, nothing to install

records.name: OptiSafari
records.tagline: Walking fog map for iPhone and Apple Watch
records.description: OptiSafari is a walking fog map for iPhone and Apple Watch. Start a GPS walk to clear fog within 50 m, even with your screen locked, and keep a map of the streets you’ve explored. Check in at 23,000+ landmarks across 49 countries and 1,400+ cities. Earn XP and painted medals as you climb from Rookie to Legend. Download maps and landmarks to explore offline, with no account required. Share your map as an encrypted file with a QR-code key.

records.name: AnalyzeIt
records.tagline: AI Data Analysis Tool That Shows Its Working With Less Token
records.description: A number moved and nobody can say why? Ask in plain English and see what changed, why, and what stands out. No SQL, no analyst, no setup. Long AI chats also stop forgetting what you said earlier and stop burning tokens: 71% fewer prompt tokens on long conversations, with earlier answers kept (18 of 18 in our test, up from 0). Use it on the web, in the CLI and desktop app, in Claude, or in your browser. Five free runs, no account.

records.name: Timeless: Daily Wisdom
records.tagline: Like doomscrolling, except you get smarter
records.description: 70 great minds, 1,812 passages. Doomscrolling, but it makes you smarter. You swipe through short quotes from Seneca, Marcus Aurelius, Naval, Paul Graham, Carl Jung and others. At the start you pick the topics and authors you care about, and the feed sticks to them. Save the ones that hit into your own collections, browse by author or topic, and share any quote as a clean image. Free: 10 new quotes a day. Everything else is a single $7.99 purchase, no subscription.

records.name: getBylines
records.tagline: Portfolio app for media professionals and content creators.
records.description: Your published work is scattered across employers, clients and platforms. getBylines keeps one private, credited record of it. Share a link from any app to save it (title, date and source fill in where the site allows it), add your role and notes, find it later by what you did, and export a PDF portfolio. Free for 100 links, with a 7-day full trial. Paid plans from ₹499 a month plus taxes add YouTube views, likes and comments. Android now; iPhone and public portfolio pages are coming.

records.name: ReelHatch
records.tagline: AI UGC ads from a prompt or a link, in minutes
records.description: ReelHatch makes finished UGC-style video ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Type a prompt, paste a product link or add photos, and an AI director writes the script, casts and voices the presenter, adds captions and music, then shoots and cuts the ad in about 9 minutes. Post it in one click or download the MP4. You see the price before you sign up, and you can make ads from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through the ReelHatch connector.

records.name: CROON
records.tagline: Live dubbing for whatever's playing on your iPhone
records.description: CROON dubs video or audio on your iPhone into your language as it plays, in a voice close to the speaker's. It works on top of the apps you already use. Turn CROON on once, then go back to your app and keep watching. When multiple people are talking, each keeps a separate voice. Free to download.

records.name: Kaabist
records.tagline: Web automation API that heals itself when sites change
records.description: Scrapers break when a site changes. Kaabist keeps them running: it re-finds moved elements, resumes after a 2FA prompt and never submits a form twice. Build the task in the visual builder, with your coding agent over MCP, or as JSON, and Kaabist runs it on schedule. Start free with 500 credits a month.

records.name: Decor DNA
records.tagline: Find your interior design style, then see your room in it
records.description: Swipe through rooms you'd love to live in and Decor DNA finds your interior design style, plus the one that blends with it. Then snap a photo of your own room and see it made over in that style in about 30 seconds, with your walls, windows and doors left where they are. Every design comes with a paint palette and a shopping list in three budgets. Renter mode keeps every idea undoable. The quiz is free, and so is your first room. Made for iPhone, including iPhone Duo.

records.name: Bard: Clipboard, Draw and Dictate
records.tagline: Keep every copy, dictate offline, sketch fast. Free + open
records.description: Bard is a free, open-source desktop app for Windows and Linux. It keeps everything you copy in one searchable history, turns your voice into text on your own machine and gives you a page to sketch on, all from the keyboard and all through your native clipboard. The design is quiet: no chrome, a small badge and a soft sound for every copy, windows that tuck away when you click elsewhere. No account, no telemetry. Built in Rust with Tauri.

records.name: Groundbox
records.tagline: Linux sandboxes for agents + faster, cheaper CI. One key.
records.description: Give your AI agents their own Linux VMs: they start in about a second, pause and fork with memory kept, and cost $0.04 per vCPU-hour with memory included. Same key runs your GitHub Actions at half GitHub's price, and one PR shows how much faster. Free to start.

records.name: ChristmasMac
records.tagline: Christmas lights, playable snow and an elf for your Mac
records.description: ChristmasMac decorates your Mac for the holidays. Lights hang on your windows and Dock, swing when you drag a window and dance to your music. Snow piles up on your windows: brush it off, roll it into snowballs and throw them. Santa flies over now and then, an elf you design lives in a little red cabin on your desktop, and you can build a snowman click by click. Plus a record player, notes, a clock, a countdown and 12 painted wallpapers. $9.99 once, yours every Christmas.

records.name: Subnano
records.tagline: Where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work
records.description: Subnano is a marketplace where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work: datasets, research, tools and articles, many with files to download. Pay per post in Nano or USDC, with no subscription. Connect Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client, and your agent can search, compare prices and buy within a limit you set, or pay over HTTP with x402. Sellers are paid to their own wallet on every sale. Can't find it? Post a Request with a brief and a budget.

records.name: Merrin: Private Personal AI
records.tagline: Private personal AI that remembers you, fully on-device
records.description: Merrin is a private personal intelligence built on local AI, for your phone and computer. Talk or type about anything on your mind, or show it a photo. It remembers the people, plans and details you mention, turns meaningful chats into entries on its own, and helps you see patterns in your own thinking. The AI model runs locally on your device: no account, no cloud AI, and it works offline once downloaded. Pair your phone and desktop with end-to-end encrypted sync.

records.name: Typeferry
records.tagline: Translate as you type on Mac and know what you're sending
records.description: Writing in a language you don't know well means copy, translate, paste, and hope it came out right. Typeferry works inside WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Gmail and most Mac apps where you type. Write in your own language and the translation appears as you go, with a back-translation underneath to catch a wrong word. If it spots a number or day that no longer matches what you typed, the line turns amber. Enter fills the box; you press send. Prefer nothing leaves your Mac? Choose on-device only.

records.name: Intraface
records.tagline: Let your Claude Code and your team's work from one board
records.description: Intraface gives your team one live HTML page on one link. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or Gemini CLI. The agent pulls the latest version and the board's rules (collab.md), edits its own copy and publishes back. Publishes queue per board, merge onto the latest version and land with the person's and the agent's name. Pin comments on the live page and agents read and resolve them. Free to start.

records.name: LikeRemote
records.tagline: Find a job faster. Hire real people, not bots.
records.description: Job hunting is broken on both sides. Job seekers jump between job boards, type the same answers a hundred times, and hear nothing back. Recruiters drown in AI-written CVs sent by bots. LikeRemote fixes both. Job seekers find the jobs that fit them in one place, apply in one click, and stand out with a short video. Recruiters meet only verified, real people, see the best fit first, and never lose a good applicant. Your first job post is free.

records.name: Xplaind
records.tagline: Free AI career roadmaps + AI mock interviews that score you
records.description: Get ready for an AI job. Built in India, for the world. Free roadmaps for 10 AI roles, from AI Engineer to AI Security Engineer: every topic has a plain-English lesson, the best course and videos, a quick check and a ready interview answer. Then take AI mock interviews that score you like a hiring panel: real questions out loud, follow-ups on what you say, and a verdict, skill scores and a 4-week plan. Plus AI resume review, tests from your own notes and an AI tutor.

records.name: The Million Dollar Pixels
records.tagline: A 1,000,000-pixel wall where startups buy a spot from $1
records.description: One wall of 1,000,000 pixels. Each pixel is sold only once. Startups, SaaS, apps and newsletters buy a rectangle from $1 a pixel, add a logo, a link and a tagline, and keep the spot for as long as the site runs. Hover shows every ad's name and tagline, and each ad gets its own page in a public directory. One-time payment, no account, no subscription. Volume discount: 20% off 5+ pixels, 25% off 20+. The first 100 buyers get a Founding advertiser badge.

records.name: CricketOrganizer
records.tagline: The cricket tournament platform with live player auctions
records.description: CricketOrganizer runs a cricket tournament in one place. Players register from one link and pay the entry fee straight to you. Teams bid in a live player auction that shows on the big screen and on every owner's phone. Fixtures are made in one click, matches are scored ball by ball on any phone, and the points table and public tournament page update from the scores. Free for up to 3 teams with every feature. After that, a one-time fee per extra team.

records.name: CitedEvidence for Chrome
records.tagline: Cite, save and get free PDFs on any paper page
records.description: A free Chrome extension for anyone who reads papers. On PubMed, Google Scholar and about 48 journal and academic sites it adds a bar under the title: cite in APA, MLA, Chicago and more in one click, find a free legal PDF, save the paper, and search 250 million works in a side panel. On any other page, open it from the toolbar.

records.name: Content Calendar & Social Media Planner
records.tagline: Plan your content, grow your audience — free forever
records.description: Plan your content, schedule across platforms, and finally see your posting rhythm at a glance. Capture ideas, build a calendar, and track status from draft to posted — free for up to 15 posts and 10 ideas. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited capacity, a Content Pillars strategy framework, monthly performance reviews, and breakdowns by platform, status, and content type. Built for creators and small teams who want structure without the overwhelm.

records.name: VersusAi
records.tagline: Random Daily Bible Verses with AI Explanations
records.description: Choose a book, chapter, and verse, or read the Verse of the Day. VersusAi is a free Bible verse app for discovering and understanding New Testament Scripture. Get optional AI-powered explanations with biblical context, meaning, and practical reflections. Read ad-free on the web or iPhone, including previously loaded passages offline.

records.name: Ada by Adanory
records.tagline: Talk or type with Ada in your browser
records.description: Ada is an AI chat you can talk to or type to in your browser. Tap the mic to speak, switch to text whenever you like, and pick up an earlier conversation from your history. Try it with a free account.

records.name: Spendifique
records.tagline: AI bookkeeping automation for receipts, invoices & expenses
records.description: Spendifique is AI-powered bookkeeping automation for bookkeepers, accountants and small businesses. Capture receipts and invoices, extract and categorize expense data, scan bank and credit card statements, match transactions to supporting documents, flag missing receipts, manage approvals, and sync clean records to QuickBooks Online or Xero. Spend less time chasing paperwork and more time on the work that matters.

records.name: Closet Studio
records.tagline: Your wardrobe, in color
records.description: Good clothes. Better combinations. A little less “what do I wear?” It’s completely open-source, and I’d love your feedback on the UI, new feature ideas, or pull requests on GitHub if you want to help build it out with me: 🌐 Live App: https://rbs2008.github.io/closet-studio/ 🔗 GitHub: https://github.com/rbs2008/closet-studio Let me know what you think! 👗✨

records.name: Lumen
records.tagline: A small moth on your Dock that reads your screen aloud
records.description: Lumen, the reading moth for Mac (formerly Narrator). Point Lumen at any part of your Mac's screen and it reads the text aloud in a natural voice, highlighting each line as it goes. It keeps up with Claude as replies stream in, reads tables row by row, and answers questions about what's on screen. The voice runs on your Mac with Kokoro: no account, no API key, and it works offline. Lumen the moth lives on your Dock and reads along. Free and open source.

records.name: Roost
records.tagline: The open-source Skool & Circle alternative you can self-host
records.description: Roost is a free, open-source alternative to Skool and Circle for teachers, creators, and independent communities. Bring discussions, classrooms, video lessons, messaging, events, member showcases, and admin tools together on infrastructure you control. MIT licensed, customizable, and self-hosted, with no software license or per-member platform fees. Hosting, storage, email, and optional external services are your responsibility. Try the read-only demo or get the source on GitHub.

records.name: Amsterdam City Planner
records.tagline: Your 1–3 day Amsterdam itinerary, with walking times
records.description: A free trip planner for Amsterdam. Pick 1–3 days and get a schedule built around opening hours, with walking times, nearby restaurants and breakfast spots, evening plans and markets. Tick your interests (museums, food, beer, nightlife, family) and the trip builder fits in the classics: Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House, the Jordaan. In English, Dutch and French. No ads, no cookies, no paid placements.

records.name: SpeakLens
records.tagline: Your meetings are your English lessons
records.description: You understand every meeting, so why do you sound junior in them? SpeakLens reviews your real calls and shows the sentence you were looking for.

records.name: MeetNewAI
records.tagline: 76,000+ AI tools with real screenshots, pricing & MCP
records.description: Find and compare AI tools without clicking through dead links or mystery pricing. MeetNewAI indexes 76,000+ AI tools across 249 categories with real website screenshots, pricing evidence, traffic estimates, and side-by-side comparisons—plus 76 LLM benchmarks & real token costs, 42 MCP servers with install snippets, 22 agent skills, 82 playable AI games, and a free stateless MCP & Markdown API.

records.name: Brisano
records.tagline: Track your brand in AI answers and see exactly what to fix
records.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI which tool to pick. Brisano asks up to 8 AI engines the questions your buyers ask, on a schedule, and shows if you're named, in what position, who appears instead and which sources the AI cited. Every answer is saved with engine, method and date. From day one it turns gaps into actions: lists to get on, pages to publish and site fixes with code ready to copy. Free checker, no signup.

records.name: The Overworked Chancery
records.tagline: A medieval paperwork game about a kingdom going broke
records.description: You're the Chancellor of a medieval kingdom on the edge of bankruptcy. Stamp petitions, catch forged seals, dodge bribes, move armies on a map, and pay the interest before the creditors take the crown. Save it, go broke, or get invaded. Free in your browser.

records.name: PhotoDoc
records.tagline: Any selfie into a studio ID photo, sized to spec. Still you.
records.description: Upload a selfie, get a studio-quality photo for passports, visas, work badges and other IDs. Face recognition checks every result against your original, so it still looks like you. Cropped to spec, print-ready. See the result before you pay.

records.name: Prop firm EV calculator
records.tagline: Prop Firm Calculator: Pass Odds, Tries and Real Cost
records.description: Prop firm ads show the account size. This shows your odds. Enter your win rate, profit factor, risk per trade and trades per day, or upload a CSV of your real trades. The calculator runs your numbers through the real rules of 1,131 futures, perps and CFD plans at 77 firms and sorts them by your pass chance. Each row shows the drawdown type, tries to pass, true cost with today's best code, and a rough look at your first payout. Free to use.

records.name: Peck
records.tagline: Woodpecker Method chess training, built from your own games
records.description: Peck is a free trainer for the Woodpecker Method: build a set of chess puzzles, then solve it again in timed cycles until the patterns stick. It can build the set from the tactics you missed in your own Lichess or Chess.com games, and it reviews any game move by move for free. A missed-puzzle queue, weekly leagues, friends, ranks, linked ratings and opening sets give you reasons to come back. No ads. Peck Pro is optional.

records.name: Eden Gen
records.tagline: Save up to 60% on AI generation. Track project spend.
records.description: Save up to 60% on select AI generation workloads. Eden Gen compares providers for the model you pick and shows the price before you run. Organize takes by project, set hard budget caps, and see who spent what on Studio. Free account. Pay per generation. Run Seedance, Kling and Nano Banana in the web app, via API or MCP. Savings example: 100 Nano Banana 2.1 images at 1K on Eden Gen Solo vs. Higgsfield Starter's effective credit rate.

records.name: PilotDeck
records.tagline: Get found on Google and in AI answers, every month
records.description: Your site launched. Now only people who already know your name find it. PilotDeck fixes that every month: • Finds what your buyers search on Google and ask ChatGPT • Writes and publishes articles to your site • Fixes technical SEO issues • Tracks where Google and AI answers name you Real result: KidKarma went from domain rating 6 to 178K Google impressions and 87 AI answers in under 8 months. 🎁 Black Friday: 30% off until Nov 30.

records.name: Peeku
records.tagline: Your clipboard, sorted at the edge of your Windows screen
records.description: Peeku saves everything you copy and keeps it one hover away at the edge of your Windows screen. Links and emails sort themselves, links open in the right Chrome profile, files drop into folders, and a paste queue pastes in order. 100% offline.

records.name: Salon: Learn Art History
records.tagline: Learn to see art, five minutes a day
records.description: Salon teaches you to really see paintings, five minutes a day. Short lessons on 20 movements, a hundred deep dives into great paintings and painters, and a quiz against the clock. You learn with your fingers: slide between two paintings, tap to find the detail, swipe to find your own taste. Thousands of masterpieces, a voice if you want one, medals and titles as you go. One payment, no subscription. The first lesson and two deep dives are free.

records.name: Nest: Family Organizer
records.tagline: The family organizer that also tracks what you spend
records.description: Nest is a shared family organizer app for iPhone, iPad and Android. Notice board, shopping lists, meal planner, calendar, tasks, birthdays, contacts, expenses, budgets and bills, synced in real time. Free for up to 3 family members, with no ads on any plan.

records.name: Planana AI
records.tagline: The personal AI coach that gets you hired
records.description: Planana is a personal AI coach for the job you want. Unlike a fixed course, your plan changes with you: every missed question or confusing idea becomes a new lesson, so nothing you struggled with gets left behind. Tech and finance roles, more soon.

records.name: Webdesly Circle
records.tagline: Loyalty tiers and experiences, without points spam
records.description: Quiet loyalty desk for luxury maisons: membership tiers, experience entitlements, and a Today board to fulfill private previews and VIP events. Not a points program, not a private club OS. Free Maison Circle Demo, no signup.

records.name: Spatch
records.tagline: Meal planning and shared grocery list for households.
records.description: Dinner decided for the week, from recipes your family already loves. Bring them in from a link, a photo or a handwritten card. Spatch plans the week favoring the ones you rate highest, merges the ingredients into one grocery list that stays in sync on every phone in the house, and walks you through cooking step by step. iPhone app and web. 30-day free trial, no card needed, then $5 a month or $40 a year.

records.name: Frontage
records.tagline: Find local businesses to pitch, and the person to ask for
records.description: I built Frontage for freelancers and agencies who sell to local businesses. Type a trade and a city, and it finds the businesses on Google Maps, reads each one's website for an email and the owner's name, and puts the easiest to reach first. Free to start.

records.name: QuAIA
records.tagline: Agentic AI for software testing, end to end
records.description: QuAIA is an open-source team of AI agents that takes the busywork out of QA, from the first requirement to the final test report. The agents review requirements, design test cases, run them, file bugs with screenshots and report the results right where your team already works, in Jira and Zephyr. No test scripts, no locators, no fixing tests after a redesign: QuAIA tests your application the way a person does.

records.name: NoteFlare
records.tagline: Encrypted notes that run free on your own Cloudflare
records.description: NoteFlare is a Google Keep-style notes app you deploy to your own Cloudflare account in one click. Notes are encrypted in your browser (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM), so the server only stores ciphertext. Free plan, works offline, imports Keep and Obsidian. MIT.

records.name: Cornerstone
records.tagline: A safe AI tutor for the whole family, with parents in charge
records.description: An AI tutor for families and homeschoolers. Every family member gets their own tutor and private chat history. Answers cite sources, Guide-me mode coaches instead of giving answers away, and parents get alerts when a chat needs attention. $9.99/month.

records.name: Sweepr 2.2
records.tagline: Swipe your iPhone clean, then compress any photo or video
records.description: Sweepr cleans your camera roll one swipe at a time: left to delete, right to keep. New in 2.2: a Compressor that shrinks any photo or video to a target size, quality or format, and keeps or replaces the original. Also new since 2.0: a glass look, albums by swiping a photo down, Places on a map, duplicate videos, Files sorting (Pro), Contacts clean-up and an iPhone Duo layout. No account, nothing uploaded, no AI deciding for you.

records.name: Crowd'd
records.tagline: Launch your game to players who buy as a group
records.description: Crowd'd features one new game each week. Players team up in a group buy, and the price gets a deeper discount as more people join. We're opening early spots for game developers: launch week on Crowd'd, fees as low as 0% for early games. If you're making a game, email me at joe@unknownlabs.net.

records.name: FreeFind 免费搜
records.tagline: Find free tools and save money
records.description: Discover 461 free and freemium tools for AI, PDF, design, education, coding and productivity. FreeFind offers bilingual search, tool comparisons, favorites and free software alternatives. Free to use, with no sign-up required.

records.name: Subtitle Translator
records.tagline: Translate SRT/VTT files and generate subtitles from video
records.description: Make your videos accessible in more languages. Translate SRT and VTT subtitle files or generate subtitles from video. Your work saves automatically, with reading speed and terminology checks to help you refine the results. Export subtitle files or an MP4 with subtitles.

records.name: Nevio - Smart IPTV Player
records.tagline: Nevio is a next-generation smart IPTV player for Android
records.description: Nevio is a next-generation smart IPTV and media player designed for Android smartphones, tablets, and Android TV devices, delivering an ultra-fast and seamless streaming experience. With a high-performance hardware-accelerated playback engine and a sleek, user-friendly interface, Nevio makes watching Live TV, Movies, and Series easier and more enjoyable than ever.

records.name: SonoLeaf
records.tagline: Listen to documents and practice one sentence at a time
records.description: SonoLeaf reads PDF, Word (.docx), EPUB and text files aloud in your browser. Follow sentence highlighting, adjust playback speed, and pick up where you left off. Use your own documents for shadowing and dictation practice.

records.name: LocalBusiness Schema Generator
records.tagline: Free LocalBusiness schema markup without writing code
records.description: Build LocalBusiness schema (JSON-LD) for a website without writing code. Pick your business type, fill in your name, address, phone, hours and service areas, and the code updates as you type. Copy it into your site's header or SEO plugin, then test it in Google's Rich Results Test. Free, no sign-up, and nothing you enter leaves your browser. Also available as a free Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension.

records.name: Workyol
records.tagline: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Google & LinkedIn in one app
records.description: Workyol puts WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages in one inbox, turns comments into DMs, sends WhatsApp campaigns to opted-in customers, schedules posts on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Google, and answers Google reviews. Official APIs. Pay once.

records.name: Brickmoat
records.tagline: Stop bot signups and fake orders on Shopify and WooCommerce
records.description: Brickmoat checks every new signup, order and store visit on Shopify and shows why each one looks fake. Risky orders are held for your call, not cancelled. Bot accounts are deleted in bulk after a CSV backup. Block visitors by country, IP, VPN or Tor while Google still gets in, and enforce your blocklist inside checkout. Free plan; paid plans from $6.99 a month with a 14-day trial. On WooCommerce? A free plugin stops card-testing attacks.

records.name: HotTake
records.tagline: Your laptop is the console. Every phone is a controller.
records.description: Turn a Windows laptop into a party-game console. Friends scan a QR code and their phones become the controllers. No app, no account, no cloud server. 51 games for up to 8 players are built in: brawls, bluffs, races and co-op. Free.

records.name: Articulate
records.tagline: Review working preferences from local coding history
records.description: Articulate turns supported local coding-agent activity into working preferences you can review and edit. Choose a project, keep what helps, and grant Codex, Claude Code or Cursor access individually through local MCP. The free testing pilot runs on your computer without an account.

records.name: unmiddle
records.tagline: ChatGPT, Claude and Grok answer and check each other
records.description: unmiddle is a Windows app that puts ChatGPT, Claude and Grok in one group chat. Ask once and they all weigh in, then check each other's answers for wrong facts, made-up sources and broken steps, so you stop copying answers between tabs to see who's right. They share your project and files, and you can talk to all three or tag just one. It uses your own API keys with a spending limit you set, and your chats and files stay on your computer. One-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: claude-carbon
records.tagline: The CO₂ of your Claude Code sessions, live and local
records.description: Claude Code shows what a session costs, never what it emits. claude-carbon adds a live CO₂ estimate to the status line and the Claude desktop app, computed locally from your token usage. Free, MIT, public methodology, nothing leaves your machine.

records.name: GitOne
records.tagline: Your GitHub, rated like an F1 driver
records.description: GitOne turns any GitHub profile into an F1 26 driver card — PAC, RAC, AWA, EXP scored live from real commits, PRs and reviews. No surveys, no self-reporting. Scout any handle: a constructor livery from your top language, a permanent driver number, six stats and an RTG out of 99. Race a rival head-to-head and export the composed race-result poster. Your card embeds anywhere as a live PNG — gitone.langersword.in/your-login.png re-scouts itself every two hours. Free and open source.

records.name: StreamSyncer
records.tagline: Live trade-call alerts for traders who follow livestreams
records.description: Trading livestreams run for hours, and the moment a streamer actually takes a trade is easy to miss. StreamSyncer listens for you. The desktop app for Mac and Windows follows the YouTube trading streams you choose, recognises speech on your own computer and sends a Telegram alert when a streamer enters or exits a trade: instrument, side, price, the trader's own words and a link to the stream. 5-day free trial, then $20 a month. Not financial advice or a signals service.

records.name: ContactZapp
records.tagline: Contact sync for every account
records.description: ContactZapp syncs your contacts between Google, Microsoft, Apple and CardDAV, both ways. Save a contact once, and it's in your work account, your personal account and your phone. It finds the same person across all your accounts and merges them, if you allow it. You keep using the apps you have. Your contacts are encrypted and backed up, and you can undo any change for 12 months. Start free, with no time limit and no card.

records.name: every gen ai video
records.tagline: Turn product photos and songs into short videos
records.description: Turn photos into AI videos at EverygenAI.im. Make short videos from product photos, animate still images with motion prompts, or create music videos from your own songs.

records.name: Synderesis Catholic AI
records.tagline: AI chatbot and assistant trained to follow Catholic values
records.description: Synderesis is a Catholic AI chatbot and assistant, built on an open-weight model retrained to align with Catholic values using thousands of examples from Church teaching. Ask questions, draft and research with answers that cite official Church sources. Spark for fast chat, Pro for deep reasoning, Labora for tasks. European AI from an EU company, in English, German and Polish, on web, Chrome and API. Free 30,000 tokens, then €5/month.

records.name: 1% reset
records.tagline: Tiny daily habits to rebuild your focus and energy
records.description: Started strong... and then lost momentum by Friday? 😩 You don't need a total life transformation. You need a 1% reset. This short, practical guide shows small daily habits to rebuild your focus, confidence and drive.

records.name: Bank Format Converter
records.tagline: Convert bank statements to Excel, CSV & accounting formats
records.description: Convert PDF bank statements and financial exports into Excel, CSV, OFX, QBO, QFX, QIF, and IIF. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, and small businesses. Digital files are processed locally in your browser; scanned statements use opt-in OCR. Review transactions, flag uncertain values, and check balances before exporting. Start with 2 free pages daily.

records.name: Invoicer
records.tagline: Scan-and-go invoices for candy, snack and drink routes
records.description: Invoicer is the invoice book for route sellers. Scan a product's barcode and it lands on the invoice with the price per box and cost and retail per piece. Prices per store, returns as credits, signatures on screen, PDF invoices, store statements and monthly reports with CSV export. English and Español. Records stay on your phone with an encrypted backup. Free, no account, no ads. Made by Dominares.

records.name: Kadaiyo
records.tagline: Zero-commission QR ordering for Chennai restaurants
records.description: Kadaiyo is a restaurant ordering app. Diners scan a table QR code to order and pay from their phone, with takeaway and the restaurant's own delivery also supported. There is no commission, so the restaurant keeps the full bill. It includes a live kitchen display and menu management. Built for restaurant and hotel owners in Chennai and Tamil Nadu with one or more branches.

records.name: Lookbk
records.tagline: Agent skills that render launch films, heroes and decks
records.description: Lookbk is a catalog of agent skills for visual work. Each skill is a folder your coding agent follows (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents that read SKILL.md) to render a finished piece on your own machine: a launch film, a website hero, a slide deck, OG images. Every preview on the site was rendered by the skill itself, so you see the real output before you install. Install with one prompt; no API key and no render credits. Free skills need no account.

records.name: Spaceport QR
records.tagline: Dynamic QR codes on your own domain
records.description: Dynamic QR codes on your own domain: change the destination after printing, cookie-free scan stats. From €0.99 per code/month, first code free for 7 days.

records.name: Muse for Chrome by Meta
records.tagline: Meta's Muse agent works in your Chrome, signed in as you
records.description: Muse from Meta puts Meta's personal AI agent in Chrome's side panel. Chat with Muse next to any page, continue your existing conversations, or hand off a whole task: research, price comparison, forms, refund follow-ups. It runs in your own Chrome, so it can use sites you're already signed in to. Muse works in its own tab group you can watch, and you take over anytime by clicking the page or pressing Esc. Purchases and other sensitive steps wait for your approval, and every action is logged.

records.name: PredictAI
records.tagline: From raw data to clear insights, predictions and decisions.
records.description: PredictAI brings AI-powered data analytics, automated machine learning, predictive modelling, document intelligence and research tools into one platform. Turn complex documents and datasets into actionable insights, build predictive models and understand their results. Currently in its testing phase, PredictAI is evolving with continuous improvements and community feedback.

records.name: Verbll
records.tagline: Join the free waitlist: train your own digital human
records.description: Free early access: join the waitlist at verbll.com. Verbll lets you train your own digital human with no code. Teach it once, it works on its own computer and keeps learning. Then run 10,000 digital humans to test an app, idea or policy before launch. Built on the Superbrain, a brain-inspired architecture with no language model inside.

records.name: Smart Kitchen
records.tagline: Find recipes with ingredients you already have
records.description: Smart Kitchen helps you decide what to cook with ingredients you already have. Explore 500+ recipes, get recipe suggestions, track fridge ingredients and expiration dates, plan meals, and create shopping lists. Available in 5 languages, Smart Kitchen makes everyday cooking easier and helps reduce food waste.

records.name: PineStorm
records.tagline: Backtest and auto-tune Pine strategies with your AI agent
records.description: Backtest your Pine Script strategies on the full Binance history. Your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex) runs hundreds of tests to tune the inputs, then checks them on unseen data. Free.

records.name: Papa's Games Hub
records.tagline: Play All 17 Free in Your Browser
records.description: Play all 17 Papa's Games free in your browser — Freezeria, Sushiria, Scooperia, Burgeria and every other Papa's shop, plus Papa Louie. No download.

records.name: ToolboxFast
records.tagline: Free Online Tools for Video, Audio, PDF & Images
records.description: ToolboxFast is a free collection of 257 online tools for everyday file tasks, from compressing a PDF to converting an iPhone video. Most tools run entirely in your web browser: your files are processed on your own device and are never sent to a server, so private documents and photos stay private. There's no account, no sign-up and no watermark. Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese, and works on desktop and mobile browsers.

records.name: Petals: Three Good Things
records.tagline: A journal where three good things a day grow a flower
records.description: Petals is a tiny journal for iPhone. Each evening you write three small things you did well, and a flower blooms. Every day gets its own flower, so a garden grows over time, with a little blue bird living in it. Free, no account, no ads.

records.name: ShowOff.life
records.tagline: Share Talent, Compete, Connect & Earn Rewards
records.description: ShowOff.life is a social platform where you can showcase your talent, share videos, join competitions, connect with creators and earn rewards. Discover new opportunities through Show, SYT (Show Your Talent), creator collaborations and communities. Your talent deserves a stage!

records.name: Vigor
records.tagline: The gym tracker that tells you what to lift next.
records.description: Vigor is a clean, fast gym and weight lifting tracker for iPhone and Android. Log a set in one tap, see last time's numbers next to every set, and keep your rest timer on the lock screen. Switching apps? Import your history from Strong, Hevy, JEFIT, FitNotes or Alpha Progression. Free with 30 routines, 200+ exercises and no account, and it works offline. Vigor Pro plans your next weight and reps, swaps an exercise when a machine is taken, and builds your program for you.

records.name: EazyRender
records.tagline: Turn SketchUp screenshots into realistic renders
records.description: Upload a SketchUp screenshot, sketch or model view and get a realistic architectural render in seconds. Change materials and lighting by chat, redesign rooms in different styles, and upscale results to 4K for free. Built for architecture and interior students, architects and designers who need presentation-ready images without a render farm. Credit packs that never expire, no subscription. Web, iOS and Android.

records.name: Crop Desk
records.tagline: Free Online Tools for Photos, PDFs, Documents & More
records.description: Free tools for online forms: resize photo and signature to 20/50/100 KB for SSC, IBPS, NEET, compress PDF, make a 2x2 or passport photo, 2027 calendar PDF. No sign-up, files stay on your device.

records.name: GetYouTubeTranscript
records.tagline: YouTube transcripts for you and your AI agents
records.description: Get the transcript of any YouTube video in about 800 ms, from a browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), the website, a REST API or a hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Search the transcript, jump to any moment, get an AI summary or ask the video questions. Python and Node SDKs. One credit per successful request; failed requests cost nothing.

records.name: NinetyRise
records.tagline: 90 Day Challenge & Habit Tracker App for iPhone
records.description: Build better habits and make real progress in 90 days. NinetyRise is an iPhone habit tracker that helps you turn one meaningful goal into 3 daily habits. Climb a virtual mountain, celebrate milestones at days 7, 30, 60 and 90, and track your progress without starting over when you miss a day. Includes a Deep Work timer, daily planning, custom habits and progress insights. Start with a 7-day free trial, followed by an auto-renewing subscription.

records.name: StudyBuddy
records.tagline: Read Less, Study Better
records.description: Import your material, let your Companion build the cards, connect them into a map, then review on the schedule your memory actually needs.

records.name: TextileGen
records.tagline: Create textile patterns, seamless repeats and colorways
records.description: TextileGen helps textile and surface pattern designers turn text, sketches, and fabric photos into reusable artwork. Generate patterns, extract motifs, create seamless repeats, explore colorways, and preview designs on garments and home textiles in one browser workspace.

records.name: Onde
records.tagline: Free sound effects you drag straight into your timeline
records.description: Search a sound, preview it, drag it into Premiere, DaVinci, Final Cut, CapCut or any editor. Royalty-free (CC0), no account, no ads. Add your own sound folders, make playlists, works offline. Windows & Mac, open-source.

records.name: Frankincense Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled frankincense oil, nothing added
records.description: Rootsar Frankincense Essential Oil is steam-distilled from the resin of the Boswellia tree. It smells warm, woody and slightly sweet, with a soft citrus lift. Nothing added, no fillers and no artificial scent. Diffuse it, blend it into a facial oil, or use it to set the mood for meditation.

records.name: KidoPulse
records.tagline: Alarm planner for kids' irregular activity schedules
records.description: Kids' lessons move, practices alternate and holidays break the routine. KidoPulse lets you set up each activity once, with one-off or repeating dates, and skip or move a single date without touching the rest. Add several alarms per activity, like pack the bag, leave the house or the night before. Alarms use Apple's system alarms, so they ring even on silent. Each child gets their own profile. No account, works offline.

records.name: Jumpman
records.tagline: Edit multiple photos at once. Free, open source, offline
records.description: Jumpman is a batch photo editor for web and Android. Select a set, edit every photo together with one look, then fine-tune any single photo without breaking the set. Auto-match fixes mixed light, a consistency score spots the odd one out, and AI sky and subject masks run on your device. Opens RAW, Lightroom XMP andcube LUTs. No account, no upload, no subscription. MIT open source.

records.name: CleanPDF PDF Editor
records.tagline: Edit PDFs in your browser. Free, private, no watermark.
records.description: Add and edit text, highlight, underline, white out, draw shapes and arrows, and drop in logos or signature images. Your original pages are never turned into images, so text stays selectable and sharp. Everything runs in your browser and your file is never uploaded. Free, with no account and no watermark.

records.name: MOZIC
records.tagline: Songs, setlists and live mode for musicians — offline too
records.description: MOZIC is one workspace for musicians, bands and teachers: songs with versions and materials, setlists, rehearsals and shows. Open live mode on stage and read charts, lyrics or scores from any device, offline included. Rehearsal rooms, studios, venues and services get a public page and take bookings or inquiries. Explore lists them all, plus a live city agenda. Free during early access. Spanish, English and Portuguese.

records.name: GeoAlarm
records.tagline: Fell asleep on the bus? Wake up at your stop
records.description: GeoAlarm is a free Android alarm that rings based on where you are, not what time it is. Pick your stop on the map, lock your phone and doze off: it rings when you get close, even with the screen off and the app closed. Motion alarms ring if someone picks up your phone or bag, and altitude alarms use the barometer to ring at a set height. No account, no ads, 30 languages. Your alarms and location stay on your phone.

records.name: SAGALITH
records.tagline: Worldbuilding Software for Writers & Creators
records.description: Worldbuilding and creative writing software with linked lore, characters, maps, manuscript editing and optional AI tools.

records.name: Lavender Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled lavender essential oil for diffusing
records.description: Rootsar Lavender Essential Oil is steam-distilled and made with botanicals free from unnecessary additives. It's 100% natural and 100% vegan. Diffuse it in the evening, blend it into a body oil, or make a pillow mist. A little goes a long way.

records.name: color_sort
records.tagline: sort vibrant balls into matching tubes
records.description: Welcome to Color Sort, the captivating, stress-relieving, and deeply satisfying color-sorting puzzle game designed to train your brain while keeping you entertained for hours! Whether you are looking to boost your focus, relax after a busy day, or test your logic skills, Color Sort delivers an unforgettable puzzle-solving experience for all ages. Color Sort challenges you to organize colored balls into glass tubes until every tube holds a single, uniform color.

records.name: Vybscan
records.tagline: Comprehensive secure SDLC: SAST, SCA, DAST, cloud posture
records.description: AI code security scanner for AI-written code, with SAST, DAST, SCA, secret, IaC, license, and typosquat scanning on GitHub and GitLab pull requests and pushes. Provides special support for unsupported frameworks such as Frappe.

records.name: Papervoice
records.tagline: Turn your PDFs into audiobooks, offline, on your phone
records.description: Papervoice reads the PDFs you own aloud with natural neural voices that run entirely on your Android phone. Import a PDF, press play, and follow along as each sentence is highlighted. Works in aeroplane mode. 15 natural voices plus your phone's own, remembers your place per book, sleep timer, speed 0.5x to 3x. No account, no subscription, no ads, no trackers, and nothing you read is ever uploaded. Free and open source (GPLv3).

records.name: Sahera AI
records.tagline: 400+ AI Workflows for Work, Learning & Creation
records.description: Use 400+ AI-powered workflows for creative production, learning, health preparation, marketing, finance, business operations, computer vision and live coaching.

records.name: Olive
records.tagline: An unbiased, on-demand advisor for pre-PMF founders
records.description: Stuck in pivot hell and second-guessing every decision? Olive is an AI advisor and objective sounding board for pre-PMF founders. Text or call to interrogate your assumptions, work through self-doubt, and decide what to test next before another cycle of building and shipping. Get an unbiased outside perspective to help you fail faster, smarter.

records.name: RootQuest
records.tagline: Learn real cybersecurity by hacking a simulated world
records.description: RootQuest is a browser game that teaches cybersecurity by doing. Each room is a simulated mission: spot a phishing email, decode data in a terminal, edit cookies in devtools, build a SQL injection or catch an attacker in the logs. After every flag, a short lesson explains the attack and the defense. 91 rooms, 36 lessons, skill exams with certificates. 22 rooms and 9 lessons are free with an account; the full game is €4.99 during launch week (then €14.99).

records.name: Dawnroom
records.tagline: Make and edit images on your own GPU. No credits, no cloud
records.description: Dawnroom is an open-source image studio that runs on your own GPU. Describe an image, get an image. Describe a change, and it edits the rest untouched. Auto mode picks a model that fits your machine, 34 open models are in the library, and nothing leaves your computer. Use the Windows Studio, the CLI, a localhost OpenAI-compatible API, or an MCP server so Claude Code and Codex can generate images for you.

records.name: Dayglass
records.tagline: Bot-free meeting notes on your Mac, readable by Claude Code
records.description: Dayglass is a private AI memory for your work day on Mac. It records Zoom, Teams and Google Meet without a bot joining, keeps audio, screen and notes on your Mac, and lets Claude Code and Cursor read your live call over MCP, so your agent knows what was decided while the call is still happening. Free for your first 10 meetings, no card. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon.

records.name: milkyway.chat
records.tagline: One AI chat for all frontier models for a better price.
records.description: Stop overpaying for AI. No more 20$ Subscriptions. Stop paying for multiple AI subscriptions. Milkyway puts all frontier models in one chat. • image generation • Live web search, file and image uploads • Voice chat and MCP connectors • Bring your own API key, pay only for features and server-costs: $1.99/month • Plans from $9/month, cancel anytime

records.name: Fenna Crew
records.tagline: Grok Bot, but open source and on your Claude Code plan
records.description: Grok Bot showed what bots with their own computer can do. Fenna Crew is the open source version that runs on your machine and uses the AI you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity. Give a bot a job and a schedule. It works in its own browser, files and docs, sheets and slides editors, never yours. Watch it, take over to type a password, and it asks before anything risky. No account, free, AGPL.

records.name: Pratico
records.tagline: Fast and secure containers for MacOS, agent and docker aware
records.description: Pratico runs containers in their own isolated lightweight VM on your Mac, using the Virtualization Framework. behind a Docker-compatible API that you and your tools already use. Images are scanned on pull, daily and blocked on findings to prevent supply chain and security issues. Outbound connections are named and checked against threat feeds; light recorder logs what each container ran. Agents get an MCP endpoint for throwaway VMs, and ask mode holds each new destination until you allow it.

records.name: SpeechScroller
records.tagline: The free teleprompter that scrolls with your voice
records.description: SpeechScroller is a free teleprompter that follows your voice. Paste your script, press start, and read out loud. It scrolls to wherever you are, waits when you pause, and catches up if you skip ahead. Includes mirror mode for teleprompter glass, adjustable text size, on-screen notes, and live words per minute. No download, no signup, and your script stays in your browser.

records.name: Conduit
records.tagline: AI front desk for aesthetic clinics, checked against Ahpra
records.description: Conduit answers every enquiry for aesthetic clinics in Australia and the UK in seconds, day and night, and books consultations with a deposit. Every patient message is checked against Ahpra and TGA advertising rules before it goes out. It works alongside Timely, Zenoti, Fresha, Kitomba and Cliniko. Plans start from A$99 a month plus a one-time setup, with no minimum term. A free check reads up to 5 public pages of your site and lists phrases Ahpra may flag.

records.name: SendPulse Gmail Extension
records.tagline: Save Gmail contacts to SendPulse mailing lists in one click
records.description: Chrome extension that adds people from your Gmail emails to SendPulse mailing lists in one click. A sidebar panel lists everyone in the conversation and shows which SendPulse lists they're already in. Name, phone, company, job title, website and LinkedIn are pulled from email signatures; noreply senders are skipped. Fields map to list variables automatically. A free, open-source alternative to a CRM for email marketing, in 8 languages. Data goes straight to the SendPulse API.

records.name: Hive
records.tagline: Feeless, 3-second blockchain for social, games, and finance
records.description: Hive is a feeless, community-owned blockchain and a public social and identity layer for the open web. Blocks are produced every 3 seconds, with one-block irreversibility. Stake HIVE as Hive Power to vote on governance and use Resource Credits for feeless transactions. HBD is an algorithmic USD-pegged stablecoin backed by HIVE. Accounts use human-readable names. Build on the open-source full stack, or extend apps with Hive accounts, posts, and payments.

records.name: WatchLog
records.tagline: Your watch collection, every watch's drift and a timegrapher
records.description: WatchLog keeps your mechanical watch collection in one place and tracks the accuracy of every watch in it. Add each watch, drawn in 3D, and see its drift at a glance. Tap as the seconds hand hits the mark: the reading is stamped with atomic time and charted in seconds per day against COSC, METAS and 18 other standards. The built-in timegrapher reads rate, beat error and amplitude through the microphone, no extra hardware. iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free for three watches, no account, no ads.

records.name: AEO Growth
records.tagline: Get more customers from AI answers
records.description: Your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI who to buy from, and they trust what they hear. AEO Growth makes sure the answer is you. You'll see where you show up in AI answers today, how you stack up against your competitors, and what's holding you back. Then our team takes care of every fix, start to finish. Start with a free AI scan.

records.name: Remeli
records.tagline: A private notebook for the people in your life
records.description: Remeli is a private notebook for the people in your life, for iPhone. Each person's page holds the details they tell you and the days you spend together. It needs no account, has no ads or analytics, and syncs through your own iCloud.

records.name: PuzzlePro: Logic Puzzles
records.tagline: 6 daily number/logic puzzle games
records.description: PuzzlePro is a collection of six logic puzzle games: Sudoku, Shikaku, Doppelblock, Math Grid, Number Snake, and Number Sums. Solve new puzzles every day, with multiple difficulty levels for every game. Whether you enjoy classic Sudoku, geometric Shikaku puzzles, challenging Doppelblock puzzles, mathematical grid puzzles, number paths, or number-sum challenges, PuzzlePro gives you something different to solve every day.

records.name: Kinjin Sticker
records.tagline: Turn your photos and inside jokes into personal stickers
records.description: Your pet, your people, your very specific sense of humor. KinJin turns them into stickers that feel like yours. Start with a photo or an idea, try an AI style, cut out the subject, add a caption, and keep a collection ready to send. Use your stickers in iMessage or export them for the places you chat. Less hunting for the right reaction. More sending the one only your friends will get.

records.name: eMood
records.tagline: Professional page layout and graphic design software
records.description: eMood is professional page layout and graphic design software for books, magazines, catalogs, and print and digital projects. It offers an intuitive visual interface in English, Hebrew, Spanish, Russian, and Arabic, with full support for left-to-right and right-to-left layouts. Built-in extensions, contextual help, and in-app support are available throughout your workflow. Download the trial for Windows or Mac.

records.name: Menu Maker - Vintage Design
records.tagline: Design vintage menus for cafes and restaurants
records.description: In today's competitive hospitality and food industry, establishing a captivating and unique menu can be a game-changer. Whether you own a hotel, shop, or restaurant, your menu is often the first point of contact with your customers. The menu is not just a list of dishes; it's your brand's visual representation, a canvas to display your culinary creativity, and a means to entice your guests. That's where our Android Menu Maker app comes into play.
